definition: Records in the NetSuite customer table with subsidiary = 2 and category NOT IN (2 Garage Experts, 14 Vendor), grouped by TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM') (cohort = record-creation month, never first-order month) and by salesrep (NULL = unassigned). assigned = COUNT(id). converted = COUNT of those records that are Customers per METHODOLOGY.md: stage LIKE 'CUSTOMER%' AND firstorderdate IS NOT NULL, measured to date at pulled_at. reps: alexis = Alexis Garcia (8766), dan = Dan Newhard (5803), parker = Parker Strong (16226); other = any other salesrep id (names listed). total_records = sum of assigned across all buckets. Query: src/data/queries/lead_routing.sql.
